verdict.rationale: Evidence shows skills.sh/vercel-labs CLI collects anonymous telemetry (skills-cli-comm-1) and lets users remove locally installed skill files (skills-cli-gh-14, skills-cli-gh-27), but there is no evidence of any user-facing control over retention or deletion of the telemetry/usage data itself, no privacy policy, opt-out mechanism, or data deletion request process. missing for 10: telemetry opt-out/consent mechanism, documented data retention policy, user data deletion/export process.
